changeSet.comment: Restore all 51 Floci Glue tables as DBeaver-visible views on Parquet/CSV. Hedge_silver now FK-based, hedge_bronze raw NDJSON. No data loss.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW hedge_silver.yahoo_ohlcv AS SELECT d.symbol, f.date, f.epoch, f.open, f.high, f.low, f.close, f.adj_close, f.volume, f.year FROM dim.fact_market_ohlcv f JOIN dim.dim_instrument d USING(instrument_id)
